lines.text: Old Jonas lives in an upturned boat on the quay: a stove, a lamp, and a smell of tar and warm bread.
Pip stands dripping on the floor, out of breath and empty-handed. He keeps looking at his hands, as if the case might turn up in them.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: You must be the trumpeter. I heard the whistles from here. Sit down before you fall down.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Um. Ruby said to find you. She said to bring her case, and I left it. I'm sorry. There were whistles.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: Whistles will do that to a person.
Jonas puts a chipped mug of something hot in Pip's hands, and for a while neither of them says anything.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: Ruby didn't get out, kid. The Squad took her, and the Cellar with her. The chairs, the piano, the stage.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [She told me to go. I went. It was the plan, and it was a good plan. Why does it feel like the worst one?]

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: You ran so there would still be someone to run to. That counts for something. It has to.

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: Whoever signs these orders wants this town quiet. I would like to know why.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Me too. Um. What do we do now?

lines.speaker: jonas
lines.text: We find the ones who are still loud. There's a drummer boy down by the docks. Teun. Loudest kid in Port Murmur, and he can't hide to save his life.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [I can't hide either. Maybe two bad hiders add up to one decent one.]
Outside, the rain keeps falling. Somewhere along the docks a drum starts up, very softly, and then not so softly.
